quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常会在留出测试数据上表现很差，这种过拟合需要被减少 [p1]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 作者指出，过拟合之所以发生，是因为特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上一起工作，而在测试数据上不能 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出的核心方法是 dropout：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，以 0.5 的概率随机从网络中省略每个隐藏单元，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 作者将 dropout 视为一种非常高效的模型平均方式，可以在合理时间内训练大量不同的网络，这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练时使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚项改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“mean network” [p5]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字数据集（60,000 张训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6][A1.SS1.p1]；
论文在多个基准数据集上验证 dropout：MNIST 手写数字数据集（60,000 张训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p6][A1.SS1.p1]；

quote: We then applied dropout to TIMIT, a widely used benchmark for recognition of clean speech with a small vocabulary.
claim: TIMIT 干净语音小词汇量识别基准 [p8]；

quote: CIFAR-10 is a benchmark task for object recognition.
claim: CIFAR-10 物体识别基准（50,000 张训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像）[p10]；

quote: In 2010, a subset of 1000 classes with roughly 1000 examples per class was the basis of an object recognition competition
claim: ImageNet 物体识别数据集（约 1000 类，每类约 1000 个样本）[p11]；

quote: We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: Reuters 文档分类数据集（201,369 篇文档，50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures
claim: 对于语音和两个物体识别数据集，作者使用单独的验证集来选择架构，然后用验证集上表现最好的架构在真实测试集上评估 dropout [p12]。

quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧的标准前馈神经网络最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，不使用 dropout 的识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的记录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者使用卷积网络达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者使用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误率，在第六个隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，使用 50% dropout 将测试错误率从 31.05% 降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: The features that dropout learns are simpler and look like strokes, whereas the ones learned by standard backpropagation are difficult to interpret.
claim: 作者还发现 dropout 使第一层特征更简单、更像笔画，而标准反向传播学到的特征难以解释 [A1.SS3.p1]。

quote: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络深度增加，准确率会先饱和然后迅速退化，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，而是深层网络难以优化 [S1.p3]。

quote: But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution

quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance
claim: 深度对图像识别至关重要，因此需要解决这一退化问题 [S1.p1][S1.p5]。

quote: In this paper, we address the degradation problem by introducing a deep residual learning framework.
claim: 深度对图像识别至关重要，因此需要解决这一退化问题 [S1.p1][S1.p5]。

quote: we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架，让堆叠的非线性层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被改写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections”
claim: 该形式通过跳过一层或多层的快捷连接实现，快捷连接执行恒等映射，其输出与堆叠层输出相加，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。

quote: we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical
claim: 当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections”
claim: 整个网络仍可用 SGD 和反向传播端到端训练 [S1.p6]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集上评估方法，该数据集包含 1000 类，模型在 128 万张训练图像上训练，在 5 万张验证图像上评估，并报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上进行了更多研究，该数据集包含 5 万张训练图像和 1 万张测试图像，共 10 类 [S4.SS2.p1]。

claim: 此外，论文还在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上采用 Faster R-CNN 进行目标检测实验，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins

claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升，1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试错误为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p5][S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.

claim: 作者表示本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿序列位置逐步计算，其固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output
claim: 作者希望提出一种不依赖循环、完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入输出全局依赖的模型架构 [S1.p4]。

quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 采用编码器-解码器结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络两个子层，并围绕每个子层使用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，即对 query 与所有 key 的点积除以 sqrt(d_k) 后经 softmax 得到权重，再对 value 加权求和 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 模型使用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.

claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型比此前报告的最佳模型（含集成模型）高出 2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 的新最优 BLEU [S6.SS1.p1]。

claim: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

claim: 实验覆盖开放域问答（Natural Questions、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG）、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

claim: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得新的最优结果（TQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上） [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: RAG 无需重排序器或抽取式阅读器即可达到最优性能，并且当正确答案不在任何检索文档中时，RAG 在 NQ 上仍能达到 11.8% 的准确率，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: RAG can generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not in any retrieved document, achieving 11.8% accuracy in such cases for NQ, where an extractive model would score 0%.
claim: RAG 无需重排序器或抽取式阅读器即可达到最优性能，并且当正确答案不在任何检索文档中时，RAG 在 NQ 上仍能达到 11.8% 的准确率，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART；人类评估中 RAG 在 42.7% 的情况下比 BART 更事实准确，而 BART 仅在 7.1% 的情况下更事实准确 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: 在 FEVER 上，RAG 的 3 路分类结果与最优模型相差 4.3% 以内，2 路分类相差 2.7% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.
claim: 通过替换索引，RAG 可以更新世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在初步实验中，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: FEVER 的另一个子任务——从 Wikipedia 抽取支持分类的句子——由于 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump，直接处理并不简单，作者希望在未来工作中解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
claim: 此外，作者尝试了 Null document 机制但未发现性能提升，因此在简单性考虑下省略 [A6.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万条任务特定标注数据进行微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models
claim: 作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模标注数据限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需自然语言指令或极少量示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。

quote: humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模标注数据限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需自然语言指令或极少量示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。

quote: scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
claim: 因此论文测试的假设是：扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: In this paper, we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model
claim: 因此论文测试的假设是：扩大语言模型规模是否能大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 论文训练了 GPT-3，一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型，参数量比此前任何非稀疏语言模型多 10 倍 [abstract]。

quote: we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
claim: 模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 个不同规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 评估时 GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]；

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning”
claim: 具体包括少样本、单样本和零样本三种设置，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

quote: We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100
claim: 具体包括少样本、单样本和零样本三种设置，少样本通常使用 10 到 100 个示例 [S1.p9][S2.p2]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。

quote: In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks
claim: 任务涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI，以及算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成等合成与定性任务 [S3.p3]。

quote: we also train a series of smaller models (ranging from 125 million parameters to 13 billion parameters)
claim: 此外，作者还训练了从 1.25 亿到 130 亿参数的较小模型，以比较不同规模在三种设置下的表现 [S1.p16]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: GPT-3 在零样本和单样本设置下取得有希望的结果，少样本设置下有时可与或偶尔超过由微调模型保持的最优结果 [S1.p11]。

quote: in the the few-shot setting is sometimes competitive with or even occasionally surpasses state-of-the-art
claim: 例如在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 81.5 F1、单样本 84.0 F1、少样本 85.0 F1；在 TriviaQA 上零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2% [S1.p11]。

quote: GPT-3 also displays one-shot and few-shot proficiency at tasks designed to test rapid adaption or on-the-fly reasoning
claim: GPT-3 还在需要即时推理或快速适应的任务上表现出单样本和少样本能力，包括打乱单词、算术和仅看一次定义后在新句子中使用新词 [S1.p12]。

quote: we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3
claim: 同时，论文发现部分任务即使对 GPT-3 而言少样本表现仍然不佳，包括 ANLI 等自然语言推理任务以及 RACE、QuAC 等阅读理解数据集 [S1.p13]。

quote: mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$
claim: 在新闻生成上，人类评估者区分 GPT-3 生成文章与人类撰写文章的准确率仅略高于随机水平，约为 52% [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: 作者承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如在文档层面语义重复、长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及偶尔出现不合逻辑的句子或段落 [S5.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: 在比较类任务上，GPT-3 单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机，例如判断两个句子中同一词用法是否相同（WiC）或一句是否蕴含另一句（ANLI），以及部分阅读理解任务 [S5.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 作者还指出模型存在结构性限制，因为实验未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能损害填空、回看比较两段内容或需要重读长文后生成极短答案的任务表现 [S5.p3]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
claim: 此外，作者承认少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]；

quote: they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on
claim: GPT-3 规模的模型推理成本高且不便，可能对实际应用构成挑战 [S5.p7]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 原文指出，在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，此前将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与 CNN 结合，要么替换 CNN 的某些组件但保留整体结构 [S1.p2][abstract]。

quote: We show that this reliance on CNNs is not necessary and a pure transformer applied directly to sequences of image patches can perform very well on image classification tasks.
claim: 原文指出，在计算机视觉中卷积架构仍占主导，此前将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与 CNN 结合，要么替换 CNN 的某些组件但保留整体结构 [S1.p2][abstract]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 作者受 NLP 中 Transformer 成功与可扩展性的启发，尝试以尽可能少的修改把标准 Transformer 直接用于图像 [S1.p3]。

quote: we reshape the image $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times C}$ into a sequence of flattened 2D patches
claim: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的二维图像块，展平后经可训练线性投影映射为 patch embeddings，并加入位置嵌入，形成序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.F1]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: ViT 将图像切分为固定大小的二维图像块，展平后经可训练线性投影映射为 patch embeddings，并加入位置嵌入，形成序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.F1]。
模型沿用 BERT 式的可学习 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 模型沿用 BERT 式的可学习 [class] token，其编码器输出作为图像表示用于分类 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: The Transformer encoder consists of alternating layers of multiheaded self-attention (MSA, see Appendix A) and MLP blocks
claim: 编码器由多头自注意力和 MLP 交替组成，每个块前使用 LayerNorm、块后使用残差连接 [S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: we remove the pre-trained prediction head and attach a zero-initialized $D\times K$ feedforward layer
claim: 微调时移除预训练预测头，接零初始化前馈层，并可在更高分辨率下对预训练位置嵌入做 2D 插值 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 作者在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 作者在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、ImageNet-ReaL、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: The “Base” and “Large” models are directly adopted from BERT and we add the larger “Huge” model.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型大小与图像块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
claim: 基线 CNN 使用将 BatchNorm 替换为 GroupNorm 的 ResNet（ResNet (BiT)），混合模型将 CNN 特征图输入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: We train all models, including ResNets, using Adam with $\beta_{1}=0.9$, $\beta_{2}=0.999$, a batch size of 4096 and apply a high weight decay of $0.1$
claim: 训练使用 Adam、batch size 4096、权重衰减 0.1，微调使用 SGD with momentum、batch size 512 [S4.SS1.p5]。

quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
claim: 在中小数据集上，ViT 在 ImageNet 上比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点，作者认为这是因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置 [S1.p4]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 但在大规模数据预训练后，ViT-L/16 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后在所有任务上超过同样在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 BiT-L，且计算资源更少；ViT-H/14 进一步提升，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 上 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
claim: 最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务上 77.63% [S1.p5]。

quote: ViT-H/14 outperforms BiT-R152x4, and other methods, on the Natural and Structured tasks.
claim: 在 VTAB 分组中，ViT-H/14 在 Natural 和 Structured 任务上超过 BiT-R152x4 等方法，在 Specialized 上前两名模型表现相近 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
claim: 作者指出，ViT 在中小数据集上不如同规模 ResNet，因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 的归纳偏置，数据不足时泛化不好 [S1.p4]。

quote: Vision Transformers overfit more than ResNets with comparable computational cost on smaller datasets.
claim: 在较小数据集上，Vision Transformer 比同计算量的 ResNet 更容易过拟合 [S4.SS3.p3]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 作者还承认，将 ViT 应用到检测和分割等其他视觉任务仍是挑战，自监督预训练与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距，且进一步扩展 ViT 可能带来性能提升 [S5.p2]。

quote: do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答事实性问题时，是基于训练中见过类似问题（即“作弊”/数据污染），还是真正从传记等来源中学习并提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型回答事实性问题时，是基于训练中见过类似问题（即“作弊”/数据污染），还是真正从传记等来源中学习并提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种情况，因此需要可控实验来研究模型如何在训练中记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种情况，因此需要可控实验来研究模型如何在训练中记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: The synthetic dataset, bioS, generates profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万人，每人六句，每句对应一个属性）和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并设计了 QA 数据集来评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: We generate a six-sentence biographical text entry for each individual, highlighting six distinct aspects.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万人，每人六句，每句对应一个属性）和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并设计了 QA 数据集来评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万人，每人六句，每句对应一个属性）和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并设计了 QA 数据集来评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: We assess this knowledge extraction using a question and answer (QA) framework.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万人，每人六句，每句对应一个属性）和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，并设计了 QA 数据集来评估知识提取 [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4][S2.p6]。

quote: Here, we pre-train the language model from scratch on the BIO data, randomly sampling and concatenating them into 512-token sentences, separated by a standard <EOS> token.
claim: 训练方式包括：预训练后指令微调（预训练仅用 BIO，微调用一半人的 QA，测试另一半人）和混合训练（同时用全部 BIO 和一半人的 QA） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
claim: 训练方式包括：预训练后指令微调（预训练仅用 BIO，微调用一半人的 QA，测试另一半人）和混合训练（同时用全部 BIO 和一半人的 QA） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing).
claim: 此外，作者提出两种近线性探测方法：基于位置的 P-probing 和基于查询的 Q-probing，用于分析预训练模型中知识在隐藏状态中的编码方式 [S5.p1]。

quote: We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
claim: 实验在 bioS 和 bioR 数据集上进行，使用 GPT2/Llama 架构（bioS 用 124M，bioR 用 302M），并对比了全量微调和 LoRA 微调 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p5]。

quote: In full finetuning a pretrained model is tuned for a downstream task such as QAs. LoRA finetuning improves upon this by freezing all pretrained model parameters and adding low-rank updates to a subset of the weight matrices for fine-tuning.
claim: 实验在 bioS 和 bioR 数据集上进行，使用 GPT2/Llama 架构（bioS 用 124M，bioR 用 302M），并对比了全量微调和 LoRA 微调 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS1.p5]。

quote: We use a parameter ${\mathsf{QA}_{r}}$ to control the QA data amount, primarily setting ${\mathsf{QA}_{r}}=0.8$ (a $2:8$ BIO to QA entry ratio).
claim: 混合训练中 QA 数据比例 QA_r 主要设为 0.8（BIO 与 QA 条目比 2:8） [S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: We focus on three augmentations: adding multiplicity, introducing permutations, and repeating full names, typically found in internet data.
claim: 知识增强实验包括多版本（multi M）、句子打乱（permute）和重复全名（fullname） [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: In P-probing, we feed biography entries into a pretrained model, and finetune an additional linear classifier on the model’s final hidden layer to predict the six target attributes
claim: 此外，还进行了 P-probing 和 Q-probing 探测实验，以及针对 BERT 类双向模型（GBERT）的对比实验 [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.p2][S7.p2]。

claim: 作者指出，LRD 中超过 70% 显示宽氢巴尔末线，表明存在大质量黑洞，其宇宙体积丰度显著高于地面类星体巡天预期，对类星体光度函数演化、宇宙再电离以及高红移黑洞快速自旋等具有重要意义 [S1.p1]。

quote: Data from the JADES, COSMOS-Web and PRIMER-COSMOS surveys show that most LRDs are not detected in the JWST/MIRI F1800W bands, and even for the detected sources, the MIRI SEDs tend to flatten from the rest-frame optical to the near-infrared (NIR) at 1–3 $\mu$ m
claim: 此外，MIRI 观测显示多数 LRD 在 F1800W 未被探测到，且探测到的源其 SED 从静止系光学到近红外趋于平坦，这与热尘埃再发射导致的极红 SED 预期相矛盾，从而引发对尘埃遮蔽 AGN 情景的质疑 [S1.p3]。

quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.
claim: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 LRD SED 模型：假设具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射嵌入延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境，紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，通过灰消光在 λ<3000 Å 建立平坦紫外谱形，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
claim: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 LRD SED 模型：假设具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射嵌入延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境，紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，通过灰消光在 λ<3000 Å 建立平坦紫外谱形，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。

quote: we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$, where $\rho_{0}$ is the gas density at the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$, and the power-law index ranges $0<\gamma<2$.
claim: 在红外波段，模型采用径向密度分布 ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^-γ，通过平衡尘埃加热与热发射冷却计算尘埃温度，并计算尘埃再发射光度，其中外半径由柱密度约束使 AV≈3 mag 确定 [S3.p3][S3.p4]。

quote: where $0<\Omega\leq 4\pi$ is the solid angle covered by dust and $r_{\rm out}$ is determined by a constraint on the column density so that the visual extinction reaches $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag to reproduce the characteristic red continuum spectra of LRDs in the rest-frame optical bands
claim: 在红外波段，模型采用径向密度分布 ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^-γ，通过平衡尘埃加热与热发射冷却计算尘埃温度，并计算尘埃再发射光度，其中外半径由柱密度约束使 AV≈3 mag 确定 [S3.p3][S3.p4]。

quote: In our model, feedback effects are incorporated by substituting $r_{\rm in}$ with $r_{\rm ph}$ in Equation ( 3).

quote: Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.
claim: 论文旨在系统性地刻画重复采样作为推理计算扩展手段的收益，即随着样本数增加，模型能解决多大比例的问题（覆盖率），以及能否从大量样本中识别出正确解（精确率）[S1.p3][S1.p5]。

quote: 1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?
claim: 论文旨在系统性地刻画重复采样作为推理计算扩展手段的收益，即随着样本数增加，模型能解决多大比例的问题（覆盖率），以及能否从大量样本中识别出正确解（精确率）[S1.p3][S1.p5]。

quote: However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.
claim: 作者指出，尽管训练计算扩展已被广泛研究，推理阶段的计算投入相对有限，用户和开发者常限制模型只做一次尝试 [S1.p2]。

quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
claim: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题用正温度从语言模型独立生成大量候选解，再用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试、Lean4 证明检查器）从样本中选出最终答案 [S1.F1]。

quote: In coding settings, our definition of coverage is equivalent to the commonly-used pass@k metric, where $k$ denotes the number of samples per problem.
claim: 覆盖率用 pass@k 的无偏估计公式计算，即至少一个样本正确的概率 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: pass@k $\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\text{\# of problems}}\sum_{i=1}^{\text{\# of problems}}\left(1-\frac{\binom{N-C_{i}}{k}}{\binom{N}{k}}\right)$
claim: 覆盖率用 pass@k 的无偏估计公式计算，即至少一个样本正确的概率 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。

quote: We start by adopting the same function class, but now modelling the log of coverage $c$ as a function of the number of samples $k$: $\displaystyle\log(c)\approx ak^{b}$
claim: 作者还用指数幂律 log(c) ≈ a k^b 对覆盖率与样本数的关系建模 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: 1. GSM8K: A dataset of grade-school level math word problems. We evaluate on a random subset of 128 problems from the GSM8K test set.

quote: We evaluate Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-70B-Instruct on CodeContests, MiniF2F, GSM8K, and MATH, generating 10,000 independent samples per problem.
claim: 对 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 在 CodeContests、MiniF2F、GSM8K、MATH 上每个问题生成 10,000 个独立样本，SWE-bench Lite 限制为 250 次尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we find that sampling up to 10,000 times per problem can significantly boost coverage on math and coding tasks
claim: 覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级上提升，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。

quote: 1. The relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled with an exponentiated power law.
claim: 覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级上提升，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。

quote: When restricted to a single sample, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct solves only 15.9% of issues. By simply increasing the number of samples to 250, we increase the fraction of solved issues to 56%, exceeding the state-of-the-art by 13%.
claim: 在有自动验证器的任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升：SWE-bench Lite 上 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56%，超过 43% 的单样本 SOTA [S1.p8]。

quote: When restricted to a single sample, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct solves only 15.9% of issues. By simply increasing the number of samples to 250, we increase the fraction of solved issues to 56%, exceeding the state-of-the-art by 13%.
claim: 弱模型加多样本可超过强模型单样本，例如 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 在竞争性编程和 Lean 证明上可超过 GPT-4o 的单样本表现 [S1.p8]。

quote: When solving MATH problems with Llama-3-8B-Instruct, coverage increases from 82.9% with 100 samples to 98.44% with 10,000 samples.
claim: 在无自动验证器的 MATH 上，多数投票和奖励模型在约 100 个样本后饱和，覆盖率从 100 样本的 82.9% 升到 10,000 样本的 98.44%，但最佳选择方法仅从 40.50% 升到 41.41% [S1.p10]。

quote: In our experiments, we explore only a simple version of repeated sampling where all attempts to a problem are generated independently of one another using the exact same prompt and hyperparameters.
claim: 作者承认实验只探索了最简单的重复采样形式，即所有尝试使用完全相同的提示和超参数独立生成，未利用解多样性、多轮交互或从先前尝试中学习 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。

quote: 1. Solution Diversity: We currently rely on a positive sampling temperature as the sole mechanism for creating diversity among samples.
claim: 作者承认实验只探索了最简单的重复采样形式，即所有尝试使用完全相同的提示和超参数独立生成，未利用解多样性、多轮交互或从先前尝试中学习 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。

quote: Our results from Section 4 highlight the importance of improving sample verification methods when tools for automatically doing so are unavailable.
claim: 在无自动验证器的领域，常见验证方法（多数投票和奖励模型）在约 100 个样本后饱和，无法随样本预算扩展，作者强调改进样本验证方法的重要性 [S5.p5]。

quote: When producing our results on SWE-bench Lite, we identified that 11.3% of problems have flaky test suites that do not produce consistent results when running them on the same candidate solution.

claim: 此外，软件任务的验证器存在缺陷：SWE-bench Lite 中 11.3% 的问题有 flaky 测试，CodeContests 中 122 个有 Python3 解的问题里有 35 个的“正确”解无法通过测试 [S4.SS2.SSS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS2.p3]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文旨在实现并验证表面码量子纠错在物理错误率低于阈值条件下的运行，从而展示逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制的特性 [S1.p1]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 原文指出，尽管许多平台展示了量子纠错的不同特征，但尚无量子处理器明确展示低于阈值的性能 [S1.p1]。

quote: These include features like stability over the hours-long timescales of quantum algorithms and the active removal of correlated error sources like leakage.
claim: 此外，容错量子计算还要求系统在数小时时间尺度上保持稳定，并实时解码综合征信息 [S1.p2]。

quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
claim: 作者在105量子比特处理器上实现距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上实现距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。

quote: We then repeat a variable number of cycles of error correction, during which measure qubits extract parity information from the data qubits to be sent to the decoder.
claim: 表面码操作包括将数据量子比特制备在X_L或Z_L基态，重复纠错循环提取奇偶信息，并在每个综合征提取后运行数据量子比特泄漏移除（DQLR）[S2.p3]。

quote: One is a neural network decoder, and the other is a harmonized ensemble of correlated minimum-weight perfect matching decoders augmented with matching synthesis.
claim: 解码方面，作者使用神经网络解码器和集成匹配合成解码器，并通过处理器数据微调神经网络、对匹配图权重进行强化学习优化 [S2.p2]。

quote: We employ a specialized version of the Sparse Blossom algorithm optimized to quickly resolve local configurations of errors common in surface code decoding, using a parallelization strategy similar to Ref..
claim: 实时解码系统采用基于Sparse Blossom算法的多线程实现，使用恒定大小的图缓冲区和块并行化策略 [S5.p2]。

quote: Using a 72-qubit processor, we implement a distance-5 surface code operating with an integrated real-time decoder.
claim: 实验在105量子比特和72量子比特超导处理器上进行，105量子比特处理器用于距离-7表面码，72量子比特处理器用于距离-5表面码和距离-29重复码 [S1.p3][S4.p2]。

quote: Using our 72-qubit processor, we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.
claim: 实验在105量子比特和72量子比特超导处理器上进行，105量子比特处理器用于距离-7表面码，72量子比特处理器用于距离-5表面码和距离-29重复码 [S1.p3][S4.p2]。

quote: We characterize our surface code logical performance by fitting the logical error per cycle $\varepsilon_{d}$ up to 250 cycles, averaged over the $X$ and $Z$ bases.
claim: 表面码逻辑性能通过拟合最多250个纠错周期的每周期逻辑错误率来表征，距离-3和距离-5子网格分别平均9个和4个不同子网格 [S2.p5]。

quote: Using our 72-qubit processor, we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots split evenly between bit- and phase-flip codes.
claim: 重复码实验运行距离-29码1000个周期，共2×10^7次采样，总计2×10^10个纠错周期，耗时5.5小时 [S4.p2]。

quote: For our distance-5 surface code, we test different problem sizes by increasing the number of error correction cycles up to $10^{6}$.
claim: 实时解码实验在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码，测试最多10^6个周期，周期时间为1.1微秒 [S5.p3][S5.p1]。

quote: The throughput of transmitting, processing, and decoding the syndrome information in each cycle must keep pace with the fast error correcting cycle time of 1.1 µs.
claim: 实时解码实验在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码，测试最多10^6个周期，周期时间为1.1微秒 [S5.p3][S5.p1]。

quote: With our neural network decoder, we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$ (see Fig. 1 c-d).
claim: 距离-7表面码的逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制，使用神经网络解码器时错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，每周期逻辑错误率ε_7=(1.43±0.03)×10^-3 [S2.p5]。

quote: The distance-7 logical qubit lifetime is $291\pm 6$ µs, exceeding the lifetimes of all the constituent physical qubits (median $85\pm 7$ µs, best $119\pm 13$ µs) by a factor of $2.4\pm 0.3$.
claim: 距离-7逻辑量子比特寿命为291±6微秒，超过所有组成物理量子比特的寿命（中位数85±7微秒，最佳119±13微秒）2.4±0.3倍 [S2.p7]。

quote: We observe that the average latency remains roughly constant at a net average of $63\pm 17$ µs independent of the length of the experiment (up to 1.1 seconds), indicating that the decoding problem is being processed in real time.
claim: 实时解码在距离-5下保持低于阈值性能，平均解码延迟为63±17微秒，且不随实验长度增加而增长 [S5.p3]。

quote: Averaging over bit- and phase-flip repetition codes, we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11, as shown in Fig. 3 a.
claim: 距离-29重复码在d=5到11之间获得错误抑制因子Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时出现偏离指数抑制，逻辑错误下限约为10^-10，由约每小时发生一次的关联错误爆发导致 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: They occur approximately once an hour, rather than once every few seconds, and they decay with an exponential time constant around 400 µs, rather than tens of milliseconds.
claim: 距离-29重复码在d=5到11之间获得错误抑制因子Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时出现偏离指数抑制，逻辑错误下限约为10^-10，由约每小时发生一次的关联错误爆发导致 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

quote: Extrapolating the projections in Fig. 1 d, achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
claim: 作者指出，尽管原则上可以通过扩大当前处理器规模实现低逻辑错误率，但在实践中资源消耗巨大；外推预测显示，达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特，使用1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。

quote: Extrapolating the projections in Fig. 1 d, achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
claim: 重复码实验识别出由关联错误爆发导致的10^-10噪声下限，作者表示尚未理解这些事件的成因，但缓解它们对构建容错量子计算机至关重要 [S4.p4][S6.p3]。

quote: Extrapolating the projections in Fig. 1 d, achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.

quote: We present Movie Gen, a cast of media generation foundation models.

claim: 论文使用两个基础模型实现广泛能力：Movie Gen Video 是 30B 参数的联合文本到图像和文本到视频生成模型，Movie Gen Audio 是 13B 参数的视频和文本到音频生成模型 [S2.p2]。

quote: We add video personalization and video editing capabilities to our foundation Movie Gen Video model via post-training procedures
claim: 作者还通过后训练过程为 Movie Gen Video 添加视频个性化和视频编辑能力 [S2.p3]。
