claim: 作者在文本到视频生成任务上与 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs、Kling1.5 和 OpenAI Sora 等先前工作进行对比，使用 Movie Gen Video Bench 提示集或公开视频进行人类评估 [S3.SS6.SSS1.p1]。

quote: we publicly release a benchmark, Movie Gen Video Bench, which consists of 1003 prompts
claim: 作者公开了 Movie Gen Video Bench，包含 1003 个提示，覆盖人类活动、动物、自然风景、物理以及不寻常主题和活动等概念 [S3.SS5.SSS2.p1]。

quote: We first compare Movie Gen Audio with 4 open-sourced models (Diff-Foley, FoleyCraft, VTA-LDM, Seeing&Hearing) and 2 blackbox commercial models (PikaLabs, ElevenLabs) on sound effect generation for single shot videos.
claim: 在音频方面，作者在单镜头和多镜头视频上评估音效生成、联合音效与音乐生成以及音频扩展，并与 Diff-Foley、FoleyCraft、VTA-LDM、Seeing&Hearing、PikaLabs、ElevenLabs 等基线比较 [S6.SS4.SSS1.p2]。

quote: On overall quality, Movie Gen Video strongly outperforms Runway Gen3 (35.02%) and LumaLabs with the net win rate beyond $2\sigma$.
claim: 在文本到视频生成上，Movie Gen Video 在整体质量上显著优于 Runway Gen3（净胜率 35.02%）和 LumaLabs，对 OpenAI Sora 取得中等净胜（8.23%），与 Kling1.5 持平（3.87%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p2]。

quote: Movie Gen Video significantly outperforms Runway Gen3, LumaLabs and Kling1.5 on both metrics, with 48.49%, 61.83% and 37.09% net win rates on realness, respectively.
claim: 在真实感和美学上，Movie Gen Video 显著优于 Runway Gen3、LumaLabs 和 Kling1.5，对 OpenAI Sora 在真实感上取得显著净胜（11.62%）[S3.SS6.SSS1.p3]。

quote: Movie Gen Audio outperforms all baselines on all metrics by a large margin: with 33.8% to 72.8% on synchronization, 27.5% to 82.2% on correctness for all videos, and 31.3% to 91.0% on overall quality for generated videos.
claim: 在音效生成上，Movie Gen Audio 在所有指标上大幅优于所有基线，同步性净胜 33.8% 到 72.8%，正确性净胜 27.5% 到 82.2%，生成视频整体质量净胜 31.3% 到 91.0% [S6.SS4.SSS1.p3]。

quote: We demonstrate that human annotators prefer Movie Gen Edit more than 74% of the time when compared to the previous state-of-the-art on the TGVE+ benchmark.
claim: 在视频编辑上，人类评估者在 TGVE+ 基准上偏好 Movie Gen Edit 超过当前最优 EVE 达 74% [S5.p3]。

quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
claim: 作者指出，视频生成模型仍然存在复杂几何、物体操作、物体物理、状态变换等方面的伪影问题 [S8.p2]。

quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
claim: 生成的音频在运动密集、视觉上较小或被遮挡、或需要更细粒度视觉理解时有时会不同步，并且由于设计选择目前不支持语音生成 [S8.p2]。

quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
claim: 作者还指出，使用人类评估定义客观标准仍然具有挑战性，人类评估可能受到个人偏见、背景等因素影响 [S8.p2]。

quote: we observe that video generation models still suffer from issues – artifacts in generated or edited videos around complex geometry, manipulation of objects, object physics, state transformations etc.
claim: 此外，模型分别针对视频和音频生成训练，开发能够联合生成这些模态的模型是重要的研究方向 [S8.p2]。

quote: However, ab initio computational methods for designing new inorganic materials are slow and scale poorly to realistically sized systems.
claim: 论文旨在解决从头算计算方法设计无机材料时速度慢、难以扩展到真实尺寸系统的问题 [S1.p1]。

quote: However, ab initio computational methods for designing new inorganic materials are slow and scale poorly to realistically sized systems.
claim: 作者希望利用深度学习在保持从头算精度的同时大幅提升速度和可扩展性 [S1.p1]。

quote: Using these methods we have developed Orb, a suite of pre-trained Machine Learning Force Fields (MLFFs) designed as general purpose, universal interatomic potentials.
claim: 其核心动机是开发通用、可商业使用的预训练机器学习力场，以替代架构受限的等变模型 [S1.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: The backbone of Orb is a Graph Network Simulator (GNS) augmented with a smoothed graph attention mechanism, where messages between nodes are updated based on both attention weights and distance-based cutoff functions.
claim: Orb 的主干是图网络模拟器，并加入了平滑图注意力机制，消息更新同时基于注意力权重和距离截断函数 [S2.p1]。

quote: The model is composed of three stages: an Encoder, Processor, and Decoder.
claim: 模型由编码器、处理器和解码器三阶段组成，解码器通过三个独立 MLP 预测总能量、每原子力和应力 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: The Decoder takes the output of the Processor and predicts the next state of the system by projecting the node representations $\mathbf{v}_{i}$ using 3 independent MLPs
claim: 模型由编码器、处理器和解码器三阶段组成，解码器通过三个独立 MLP 预测总能量、每原子力和应力 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Orb models are trained in two distinct phases - first they are trained as Denoising Diffusion models using a dataset of ground state materials.
claim: 训练分两阶段：先以基态材料数据做去噪扩散预训练，再微调为预测能量、力和应力的神经网络势 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: At inference time, our model requires a single forward pass to produce $E,\mathbf{f}_{i}$ and $\boldsymbol{\sigma}$, as we do not implement our forcefield as a conservative vector field.
claim: 模型非保守，直接预测力而非能量梯度，并通过去净力和去净扭矩操作保证力的物理性质 [S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2][S6.SS3.p3][S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: The first modification is a mean-subtraction
claim: 模型非保守，直接预测力而非能量梯度，并通过去净力和去净扭矩操作保证力的物理性质 [S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2][S6.SS3.p3][S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: The second modification is to remove net torque in non-pbc systems.
claim: 模型非保守，直接预测力而非能量梯度，并通过去净力和去净扭矩操作保证力的物理性质 [S2.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p2][S6.SS3.p3][S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: For pretraining, we curate a dataset of minimum energy configurations of materials, regardless of exchange-correlation functional, DFT software implementation or correction.
claim: 预训练使用不限交换关联泛函和 DFT 软件的最低能量构型数据集，微调则组合 MPtraj 与 Alexandria，二者均使用 PBE 泛函、VASP 几何优化 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p1][S2.SS3.SSS3.Px1.p1]。

quote: Here, we follow previous work in combining MPtraj, the dataset constructed from the Materials Project and used to train CHGNet, with Alexandria, as both use PBE exchange-correlation functionals
claim: 预训练使用不限交换关联泛函和 DFT 软件的最低能量构型数据集，微调则组合 MPtraj 与 Alexandria，二者均使用 PBE 泛函、VASP 几何优化 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p1][S2.SS3.SSS3.Px1.p1]。

quote: We evaluate Orb on the widely adopted Matbench-Discovery benchmark.
claim: 在 Matbench-Discovery 基准上评估几何优化和稳定性预测，使用 FIRE 优化器最多 500 步或力低于 0.05 eV/Å [S3.SS1.p1][S3.T1]。

quote: Structures are relaxed using Orb and the FIRE optimizer for 500 steps or until the maximum force magnitude is lower than 0.05 eV/Å.
claim: 在 Matbench-Discovery 基准上评估几何优化和稳定性预测，使用 FIRE 优化器最多 500 步或力低于 0.05 eV/Å [S3.SS1.p1][S3.T1]。

quote: We evaluate Orb on the MD17-10k benchmark, following the protocol of.
claim: 在 MD17-10k 基准上评估小分子 NVT 分子动力学，包括系统特定微调和零样本设置 [S3.SS4.p1][S3.SS4.SSSx2.p1]。

quote: It is therefore of interest to directly evaluate Orb without additional finetuning.
claim: 在 MD17-10k 基准上评估小分子 NVT 分子动力学，包括系统特定微调和零样本设置 [S3.SS4.p1][S3.SS4.SSSx2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate the MD stability of the well-studied MOF-5, recorded to be stable up to temperatures of 723 K
claim: 此外在 MOF-5 上评估不同温度下的 MD 稳定性，并用 Widom 插入评估 Mg-MOF-74 的 CO2 吸附 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: To investigate the adsorption properties of Mg-MOF-74 at low pressures, we use Widom insertion using Orb-D3 to compute the heat of adsorption and free energy landscape of $\text{CO}_{2}$.
claim: 此外在 MOF-5 上评估不同温度下的 MD 稳定性，并用 Widom 插入评估 Mg-MOF-74 的 CO2 吸附 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: For both sections, Orb models set a new state-of-the art across the primary metric (F1), and are generally superior across other metrics.
claim: 在 Matbench Discovery 上，Orb 在主要指标 F1 上创下新最优，且精度尤其高 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In addition to the substantial decreases in forcefield error, diffusion pretraining also makes training more stable
claim: 扩散预训练普遍带来 17% 到 70% 的改进，并使训练更稳定 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.F2]。

quote: Diffusion pretraining helps universally with improvements between 17% and 70%
claim: 扩散预训练普遍带来 17% 到 70% 的改进，并使训练更稳定 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.F2]。

quote: At large system sizes, Orb is between 3 to 6 times faster than MACE.
claim: 在大体系下 Orb 比 MACE 快 3 到 6 倍 [S3.F3]。

quote: Orb demonstrates excellent stability, achieving the maximum 300ps for all molecules, putting it on par with NequIP and ahead of all other baseline models.
claim: 在 MD17-10k 系统特定设置中，Orb 对所有分子达到最大 300 ps 稳定性，与 NequIP 相当 [S3.SS4.SSSx1.Px1.p1]。

quote: Comparing just those models trained on MPtraj, we see that Orb has the best performance, with a lower $h(r)$ across the board.
claim: 零样本设置下 Orb (MPtraj) 优于 MACE 和 Sevennet，但作者认为四个模拟样本难以稳健判断优越性 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px1.p1][S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。

quote: Whilst Orb (MPtraj) does outperform MACE and Sevennet (Table 3), all models are reasonably close in performance and it is hard to make a robust judgement of superiority from a sample size of four simulations.
claim: 零样本设置下 Orb (MPtraj) 优于 MACE 和 Sevennet，但作者认为四个模拟样本难以稳健判断优越性 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px1.p1][S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。

quote: Here, we show that Orb produces stable MD trajectories for MOF-5 across a range of different temperatures.
claim: 在 MOF-5 上 Orb 在 300-800 K 产生稳定轨迹，并复现了实验观察到的苯撑环动力学 [S3.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In contrast, Orb-D3’s shallower wells closer to the experimental value, with a heat of adsorption of -54.9 kJ/mol.
claim: 在 Mg-MOF-74 吸附中，Orb-D3 的吸附热为 -54.9 kJ/mol，比 MACE+D3 的 -61.7 kJ/mol 更接近实验值 -44 kJ/mol [S3.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: it is hard to make a robust judgement of superiority from a sample size of four simulations.
claim: 作者指出，零样本 MD17 评估仅基于四个模拟，难以稳健判断模型优越性，且加入 Alexandria 后性能下降可能不具统计显著性 [S3.SS4.SSSx2.Px2.p1]。

quote: The higher interaction energies and heats of adsorption suggest that further fine-tuning data may be required to get quantitatively correct heats of adsorption
claim: 在吸附任务中，Orb 和 MACE 均未在 MOF 结构上训练，较高的相互作用能和吸附热表明可能需要进一步微调数据才能定量正确地采样势能面 [S3.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: Arguably, we have only scratched the surface of this approach through our use of diffusion modeling on ground-states, and we believe that the use of full trajectory data is a promising direction for future work.
claim: 作者还表示，扩散预训练仅在地态上使用，利用完整轨迹数据是未来有前景的方向 [S4.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。

quote: however this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型难以生成可靠的熔盐热物理数据，尤其是 LiF 的黏度在经典势模拟中存在温度轴上的偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型难以生成可靠的熔盐热物理数据，尤其是 LiF 的黏度在经典势模拟中存在温度轴上的偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
claim: 作者希望借助快速发展的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并报告 MACE 势计算黏度相对于实验数据的准确性 [S1.p4]。

quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
claim: 作者对熔融 LiF 进行分子动力学模拟：经典势（Buckingham 和 BHM）通过 DL_POLY 包，MACE 机器学习势通过 python 包 janus-core 使用 MACE_MP_0（small 版本）[S2.p1]。

quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
claim: 两种情况下均使用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力张量自相关积分计算黏度 [S2.p1]。

quote: For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of $1$ fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across $20$ initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
claim: 统计采集使用 NVE 系综，时间步长 1 fs，轨迹长度 1 ns，并对 20 个独立初始构型取平均 [S2.p2]。

quote: In both we use a system size of $N=512$ atoms
claim: 体系大小为 N=512 原子，MACE 模拟的墙钟时间通常比基于经典势的 CPU DL_POLY 计算长一个数量级 [S2.p3]。

quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.
claim: 作者将三种计算模型（MACE、BHM、Buckingham）得到的黏度与实验数据进行比较 [S3.p1]。

quote: in Figure 2 we show the system volume $V$ for the MACE, Buckingham, and BHM models following a gradual monotonic heating from a crystal structure up to $1250$ K.
claim: 为探究经典势黏度偏移的原因，作者从晶体结构出发以 10 K 到 1250 K 逐步单调加热，观察体系体积变化以确定熔点 [S3.p2]。

quote: First we show the velocity autocorrelation functions (VAFs) of the Buckingham and MACE models in figure 3, with the resultant densities of states (DOS) of each included as insets.
claim: 此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS）[S3.p4][S3.F3]，并在相同温度下计算了部分径向分布函数（RDF）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。

quote: The temperatures of 890 K and 1147 K were chosen to compare the VAFs just above the melting points of the Buckingham and MACE potentials respectively.
claim: 此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS）[S3.p4][S3.F3]，并在相同温度下计算了部分径向分布函数（RDF）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。

quote: Next we look at the partial RDFs $g(r)$ in Figure 4, and the structure factors derived from them in Figure 5.
claim: 此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS）[S3.p4][S3.F3]，并在相同温度下计算了部分径向分布函数（RDF）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。
此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS）[S3.p4][S3.F3]，并在相同温度下计算了部分径向分布函数（RDF）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。
此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数（VAF）和态密度（DOS）[S3.p4][S3.F3]，并在相同温度下计算了部分径向分布函数（RDF）和结构因子 S(k) [S3.p5][S3.F4][S3.F5]。

quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models: the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
claim: MACE 模型计算的黏度在整个温度范围内与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型的黏度在温度轴上存在约 300 K 的偏移 [S3.p1]。

quote: We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.
claim: 从晶体结构逐步加热的模拟显示，MACE 模拟的熔点与实验熔点吻合良好，而经典势低估熔点约 300 K（实验值为 1121 K，也有记录为 1143 K）[S3.p2]。

quote: We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
claim: VAF 分析表明，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的振荡频率降低，且两者 VAF 出现更深且深度相近的极小值，形状非常相似，而经典 VAF 存在明显的定性差异 [S3.p4]。

quote: The first and second peaks of each model are located at approximately the same radial separation, with the MACE peak heights slightly lower and the peak positions slightly higher than those of the classical RDFs.
claim: RDF 分析显示，各模型的第一、第二峰位置大致相同，但 MACE 峰高略低、峰位略高，表明 MACE 模拟的配位环境更宽 [S3.p5]。

quote: average structures can be quite similar, yet dynamics and transport properties can differ substantially as we saw for viscosity results earlier.
claim: 作者指出，平均结构可以相似，但动力学和输运性质可能显著不同 [S3.p6]。

quote: For these and other reasons, gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point
claim: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有实验中的自由表面或界面，以及 MD 模拟体系尺寸较小，缺少长波长和低频声子，因此从晶体结构逐步加热的方法可能并不普遍准确 [S3.p3]。

quote: For these and other reasons, gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point
claim: 作者明确表示，本工作的目标和重点是输运性质（如黏度）的计算和预测，而非准确确定熔点，后者留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。

quote: In order to increase the calculation cutoff radius and see the peaks reduce further and the g(r) tend to 1 we would need a larger system. For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
claim: 此外，由于计算时间和资源的限制，使用 MACE-MP-0 无法采用更大体系来增加计算截断半径以观察 RDF 峰进一步衰减并趋于 1 [S3.p5]。

quote: The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.
claim: 作者还提到，MACE 势的计算负载高于经典两体势 [S4.p1]，且通过专门针对 LiF 熔融相、使用更多训练数据的专用势可以获得更好的结果 [S4.p1]。

quote: What are the tradeoffs between precision, parameters, and data? How do they compare for pretraining and inference?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：精度、参数量和数据之间存在怎样的权衡，以及这些权衡在预训练和推理时有何不同 [S1.p1]。

quote: What are the tradeoffs between precision, parameters, and data? How do they compare for pretraining and inference?
claim: 原文指出，精度是同时影响成本和性能的第三个重要因素，而当前的缩放定律并未考虑这一点 [S1.p1]。

quote: This functional form that posits bit precision and parameter count interchangeably contribute to a model’s “effective parameter count,” $N_{\text{eff}}$
claim: 论文提出用“有效参数量” N_eff 来统一建模精度与参数量的互换关系，并假设量化实现细节仅通过影响 N_eff 来影响损失缩放 [S1.p2]。

quote: we find the best fit for the tradeoff between weight precision and parameters is $N_{\text{eff}}(N,P_{\text{w}})=N(1-e^{-P_{\text{w}}/\gamma_{\text{w}}})$
claim: 对于训练，作者将 Chinchilla 缩放形式中的 N 替换为 N_eff(N, P_w)=N(1-e^{-P_w/γ_w}) [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: $L(N,D)=A[N(1-e^{-P_{\text{w}}/\gamma_{\text{w}}})]^{-\alpha}+BD^{-\beta}+E$
claim: 对于训练，作者将 Chinchilla 缩放形式中的 N 替换为 N_eff(N, P_w)=N(1-e^{-P_w/γ_w}) [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: $N_{\text{eff}}(P)=N(1-e^{-P_{\text{w}}/\gamma_{\text{w}}})(1-e^{-P_{\text{a}}/\gamma_{\text{a}}})(1-e^{-P_{\text{kv}}/\gamma_{\text{kv}}})$
claim: 对于权重、激活和 KV 缓存的联合量化，作者提出独立乘性的 N_eff 形式 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
claim: 对于权重、激活和 KV 缓存的联合量化，作者提出独立乘性的 N_eff 形式 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: the predicted loss for a language model with $N$ parameters, trained on $D$ tokens, with training precision $P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}}$ to end-time weight-precision $P_{\text{post}}$, can be predicted as $L(N,D,P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}},P_{\text{post}})=AN_{\text{eff}}^{-\alpha}+BD^{-\beta}+E+\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$
claim: 最终将训练和推理的缩放定律统一为包含后训练量化退化项 δ_PTQ 的单一函数形式 [S5.p8]。

quote: We train and evaluate a suite of OLMo-style models on the Dolma V1.7 dataset, using a standard Transformer++ implementation
claim: 作者在 Dolma V1.7 数据集上训练和评估了一系列 OLMo 风格的模型，使用标准 Transformer++ 实现 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We train and evaluate a suite of OLMo-style models on the Dolma V1.7 dataset, using a standard Transformer++ implementation
claim: 实验扫描了 N∈[30,60,110,220] 百万非嵌入参数和 D∈[1.5,3,6,13,26] 十亿 token，每个 (N,D) 组合运行超过 20 次，并扫描 8 个精度值 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We sweep the training precisions of the weights, activations, and KV cache $P_{\text{w}},P_{\text{a}},P_{\text{kv}}\in[3,12]$ individually, as well as training BF16 baselines.
claim: 训练精度扫描覆盖 P_w,P_a,P_kv∈[3,12] 以及 BF16 基线 [S4.p1]。

quote: We fit on over 465 pretraining runs and validate our predictions on model sizes up to 1.7B parameters trained on up to 26B tokens.
claim: 作者在超过 465 次预训练运行上拟合，并在高达 1.7B 参数、26B token 的模型上验证预测 [abstract]。

quote: We find that the degradation $\delta_{\text{PTQ}}$ increases in training data size across all model sizes, but that for a fixed dataset size larger models incur a smaller degradation.
claim: 后训练量化带来的损失退化随训练数据量增加而增大，对于固定模型，当 D/N 足够大或 P_post 足够小时，量化后损失可能随预训练时间延长而增加 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS1.p3]。

quote: This implies that when $D/N$ is sufficiently large, or $P_{\text{post}}$ sufficiently small, loss after quantization can increase as models are pretrained for longer
claim: 后训练量化带来的损失退化随训练数据量增加而增大，对于固定模型，当 D/N 足够大或 P_post 足够小时，量化后损失可能随预训练时间延长而增加 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS1.p3]。

quote: The effects of quantizing the weights, activations, and KV cache during training are well modeled as independent and multiplicative
claim: 训练中量化权重、激活和 KV 缓存的效果可被建模为独立且乘性的，统一通过 N_eff 影响损失 [S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: which reveals that in general the optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute budget.
claim: 当 N、D、P 联合优化时，计算最优预训练精度与计算预算无关，拟合结果约为 7-8 比特 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p2]。

quote: When $N,D,P$ are optimized jointly, compute-optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute.
claim: 当 N、D、P 联合优化时，计算最优预训练精度与计算预算无关，拟合结果约为 7-8 比特 [S4.SS3.SSS2.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p2]。

quote: our scaling laws predict that models of differing sizes should not necessarily be trained in the same precision, and that compute-optimal precision scales as $P^{*}(C)\propto\log C$.
claim: 当 N 固定时，计算最优精度随计算预算对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS3.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p2]。

quote: When $N,D,P$ are optimized jointly, compute-optimal pretraining precision is independent of compute.
claim: 当 N 固定时，计算最优精度随计算预算对数增长 [S4.SS3.SSS3.p1][S4.SS3.SSS3.p2]。

quote: we find a strong fit with $R^{2}=0.90$ on over 1000 data points (each of 465 pretraining runs post-train quantized to multiple precisions).
claim: 统一缩放定律在超过 1000 个数据点上取得 R²=0.90 的拟合 [S5.p6]。

quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
claim: 作者承认，全文使用固定架构来考察精度、参数和 token 的影响，而低精度训练常涉及架构调整，可能缩小与全精度模型的差距 [S6.p2]。

quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
claim: 计算成本虽随精度线性缩放，但由于系统开销，减半精度带来的收益通常不到 2 倍 [S6.p2]。

quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
claim: 作者仅考虑损失缩放，未进行下游模型评估 [S6.p2]。

quote: First, we use a fixed architecture throughout to examine the effects of precision, parameters, and tokens in a controlled manner.
claim: 作者强调所发现的趋势旨在提供启示而非规定性结论，并希望未来工作能在更大模型规模上更全面地检验这些效应 [S6.p2]。

quote: To further push the boundaries of open-source model capabilities, we scale up our models and introduce DeepSeek-V3, a large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 671B parameters, of which 37B are activated for each token.
claim: 论文旨在进一步推动开源模型能力边界，通过扩大模型规模并引入 DeepSeek-V3 来缩小与闭源模型的差距 [S1.p1]。

quote: With a forward-looking perspective, we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs.
claim: 同时，研究追求强模型性能与经济成本的平衡，探索在高效训练和推理下保持模型性能 [S1.p2]。

quote: DeepSeek-V3 still adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient inference and DeepSeekMoE for cost-effective training.
claim: DeepSeek-V3 采用 MLA 实现高效推理、DeepSeekMoE 实现经济训练，并首创无辅助损失的负载均衡策略以最小化负载均衡对模型性能的不利影响 [S1.p2]。

quote: DeepSeek-V3 still adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient inference and DeepSeekMoE for cost-effective training.
claim: 同时设置多 token 预测训练目标以增强评估基准上的整体性能 [S1.p2]。

quote: we introduce an FP8 mixed precision training framework and, for the first time, validate its effectiveness on an extremely large-scale model.
claim: 训练支持 FP8 混合精度，并设计 DualPipe 算法实现高效流水线并行，通过计算-通信重叠隐藏大部分通信 [S1.p3]。

quote: During pre-training, we train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T high-quality and diverse tokens.
claim: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多样化 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段上下文扩展至 32K 和 128K [S1.p4][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We set the maximum sequence length to 4K during pre-training, and pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens.
claim: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多样化 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段上下文扩展至 32K 和 128K [S1.p4][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We curate our instruction-tuning datasets to include 1.5M instances spanning multiple domains, with each domain employing distinct data creation methods tailored to its specific requirements.
claim: 后训练包括 SFT 和 RL，SFT 数据集包含 1.5M 实例，RL 采用 GRPO [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

quote: Similar to DeepSeek-V2, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which foregoes the critic model that is typically with the same size as the policy model, and estimates the baseline from group scores instead.
claim: 后训练包括 SFT 和 RL，SFT 数据集包含 1.5M 实例，RL 采用 GRPO [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

quote: we compare the base model of DeepSeek-V3 with the state-of-the-art open-source base models, including DeepSeek-V2-Base (our previous release), Qwen2.5 72B Base, and LLaMA-3.1 405B Base.
claim: 评估覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、数学、代码等基准，并与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 等开源模型比较 [S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.
claim: 综合评估显示 DeepSeek-V3 优于其他开源模型，性能与领先闭源模型相当 [abstract]。

quote: DeepSeek-V3-Base achieves the best performance on most benchmarks, especially on math and code tasks.
claim: 基础模型在多数基准上表现最佳，尤其在数学和代码任务上 [S4.T3]。

quote: Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models, including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, on a series of standard and open-ended benchmarks.
claim: 聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，并与 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 相当 [S1.p5]。

quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.
claim: 训练过程稳定，未出现不可恢复的损失尖峰或回滚 [abstract]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
claim: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
claim: 此外，尽管端到端生成速度已超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍，仍有进一步提升空间 [S6.p2]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
claim: 这些局限有望随更先进硬件的发展自然解决 [S6.p2]。

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts.
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习框架自我演化出推理能力，从而尽量减少对人类标注的依赖 [S1.p2]。

quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases.
claim: 作者指出，现有依赖人工标注推理轨迹的方法存在可扩展性差、引入认知偏差、性能受限于人类示例等问题 [S1.p1]。

quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework.
claim: 作者基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）作为强化学习框架，奖励信号仅基于最终预测答案与标准答案的正确性，不约束推理过程本身 [S1.p2]。

quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework.
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 跳过了传统的监督微调阶段，仅使用规则奖励（准确率奖励和格式奖励）进行训练 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: Our rule-based reward system mainly consists of two types of rewards: accuracy rewards and format rewards.
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 跳过了传统的监督微调阶段，仅使用规则奖励（准确率奖励和格式奖励）进行训练 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 为解决可读性和语言混杂问题，作者进一步提出 DeepSeek-R1，采用整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调的多阶段训练框架 [S1.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024).
claim: 作者在 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 等基准上评估模型 [S4.p1]。

quote: For the training of DeepSeek-R1-Zero, we employed 64*8 H800 GPUs, and the process required approximately 198 hours.
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 的训练使用 64*8 H800 GPU，约 198 小时；DeepSeek-R1 训练约 80 小时 [A2.SS4.SSS4.p1]。

quote: in the mathematics domain alone, our decontamination process identified and removed approximately six million potential pre-training texts.
claim: 作者还进行了去污染处理，在数学领域移除了约六百万条潜在预训练文本 [A4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%.
claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的平均 pass@1 从初始的 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，结合自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 训练过程中模型自然涌现出反思、验证和探索替代方案等高级推理行为，并出现“aha moment” [S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: On math tasks, DeepSeek-R1 demonstrates performance on par with OpenAI-o1-1217, surpassing other models by a large margin.
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在 Codeforces 上超越 96.3% 的人类参与者 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3][A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p4]。

quote: On the Codeforces platform, DeepSeek-R1 outperforms 96.3% of human participants
claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在 Codeforces 上超越 96.3% 的人类参与者 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3][A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p4]。

quote: These distilled models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, surpassing the performance of their original instruction-tuned counterparts.
claim: 蒸馏后的小模型在推理基准上超越了其原始指令微调版本 [S1.p4]。

quote: Currently, the structural output capabilities of DeepSeek-R1 remain suboptimal compared to existing models.
claim: 作者明确承认 DeepSeek-R1 存在多项能力局限：结构化输出能力欠佳，且无法利用搜索引擎、计算器等工具 [S6.p3]；

quote: there remains room for further optimization in terms of token efficiency, as instances of excessive reasoning—manifested as overthinking—are still observed in response to simpler questions.
claim: token 效率仍有优化空间，简单问题上仍存在过度思考 [S6.p4]；

quote: DeepSeek-R1 is currently optimized for Chinese and English, which may result in language mixing issues when handling queries in other languages.
claim: 目前仅针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混杂 [S6.p5]；

quote: When evaluating DeepSeek-R1, we observe that it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance.
claim: 对提示敏感，few-shot 提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]；

quote: large-scale RL has not been applied extensively in software engineering tasks. As a result, DeepSeek-R1 has not demonstrated a huge improvement over DeepSeek-V3 on software engineering benchmarks.
claim: 由于评估耗时长影响 RL 效率，软件工程任务未大规模应用 RL，在软件工程基准上未展现出对 DeepSeek-V3 的巨大提升 [S6.p7]。

quote: for complex tasks that cannot be effectively evaluated by a reliable reward model, scaling up pure RL methods remains an open challenge.
claim: 此外，纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励攻击挑战，对于无法由可靠奖励模型有效评估的复杂任务，扩展纯 RL 仍是开放问题 [S6.p9]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，最简单的实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但缺乏公开的简单方法 [S1.p1]。

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是通过质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题及推理轨迹构成 s1K 数据集 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]；

quote: we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是通过质量、难度、多样性三个准则筛选出 1,000 个问题及推理轨迹构成 s1K 数据集 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]；

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 二是预算强制（budget forcing），在解码时通过强制插入思考结束符或追加“Wait”来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 二是预算强制（budget forcing），在解码时通过强制插入思考结束符或追加“Wait”来控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 核心思想是用极少量样本进行监督微调，并在测试时通过简单干预控制计算量 [S1.p2]。

quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B
claim: 论文在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上使用 s1K 进行监督微调，训练在 16 块 H100 GPU 上耗时 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 评估使用三个推理基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），采用温度 0 的贪婪解码，测量准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Here we test the importance of combining them and the overall efficacy of our selection.
claim: 此外还进行了数据消融（比较随机选择、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K 等）和测试时扩展方法消融（预算强制、条件控制、拒绝采样等） [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.
claim: 此外还进行了数据消融（比较随机选择、仅多样性、仅难度、全量 59K 等）和测试时扩展方法消融（预算强制、条件控制、拒绝采样等） [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学问题上超过 o1-preview 最高达 27%（MATH 和 AIME24） [abstract]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: 通过预算强制，s1-32B 在 AIME24 上从 50% 外推至 57% [abstract]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 数据消融表明，联合使用质量、难度、多样性准则至关重要，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致性能显著下降（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全量 59K 样本相比 1K 选择并未带来实质提升 [S1.p3]。

quote: we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.
claim: 在测试时扩展方法中，预算强制提供了完美的控制性、良好的扩展斜率和最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
claim: 作者指出预算强制在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：性能最终会趋于平缓，且受底层语言模型的上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 此外，抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: Complex reasoning has long been considered one of the most challenging capabilities to instill in large language models (LLMs).
claim: 原文指出，传统范式基于两个假设——掌握复杂认知过程需要大量监督示范，且监督微调主要导致记忆而非真正泛化 [S1.p1]。

quote: We argue this data-intensive paradigm may no longer be necessary.
claim: 作者认为这种数据密集型范式可能不再必要，因为现代基础模型已在预训练中编码大量数学知识，挑战从知识获取转变为知识激发 [S1.p2]。

quote: In foundation models where domain knowledge has been comprehensively encoded during pre-training, sophisticated reasoning capabilities can emerge through minimal but precisely orchestrated demonstrations of cognitive processes.
claim: 作者提出 LIMO 假说，认为在预训练已全面编码领域知识的基础模型中，复杂推理可通过少量但精确编排的认知过程示范涌现，其两个前提是模型参数中潜在存在前置知识，以及推理链能将复杂问题分解为详细逻辑步骤 [S3.p1]。

quote: we first applied a baseline difficulty filter using a short-CoT mathematical model, Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct.
claim: 方法上，作者构建了一个多层过滤的数据筛选流程：先用 Qwen2.5-Math-7B-Instruct 做粗难度过滤，再用 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 采样 32 次保留仅解出 1–3 次的问题，得到 2,125 个问题的 LIMO-Pool [S3.SS1.SSS1.p3]。

quote: we employed three state-of-the-art reasoning models—DeepSeek R1, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B, and QwQ-32B —sampling multiple solutions from each to generate diverse reasoning approaches.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并基于规则评分系统按详细推理、自我验证、探索性方法和自适应粒度四个维度打分，选出最高分的 800 个样本构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we implemented a rule-based scoring system that calculated weighted metrics for each dimension.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并基于规则评分系统按详细推理、自我验证、探索性方法和自适应粒度四个维度打分，选出最高分的 800 个样本构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: we selected the highest-scoring solution for each problem, ranked these pairs by quality score, and extracted the top 800 to form the LIMO Dataset.
claim: 随后用 DeepSeek R1、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 和 QwQ-32B 生成推理链，并基于规则评分系统按详细推理、自我验证、探索性方法和自适应粒度四个维度打分，选出最高分的 800 个样本构成 LIMO 数据集 [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p6][S3.SS1.SSS2.p7]。

quote: We fine-tune Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using supervised fine-tuning on our LIMO dataset.
claim: 训练上，作者对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 进行全参数监督微调，使用 DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 和 FlashAttention-2，学习率 5.0e-6，余弦衰减，省略 warmup，训练 15 个 epoch，batch size 为 64 [S4.p2]。

quote: the American Invitational Mathematics Examination (AIME24), MATH500, and the American Mathematics Competitions (AMC23).
claim: 评估框架包含域内和分布外两部分：域内使用 AIME24、MATH500 和 AMC23 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]；

quote: we include diverse mathematical competitions like OlympiadBench to test performance on different mathematical challenges.
claim: 分布外使用 OlympiadBench、CHMath、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool、Minerva 和 GPQA [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 所有基准采用零样本思维链下的 pass@1 指标，较大基准用贪心解码单样本，小于 50 题的基准生成 4 个样本（temperature=0.6）计算无偏 pass@1，最大输出长度 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: These include OpenAI-o1-preview, a large language model that has demonstrated advanced mathematical reasoning abilities across various complex tasks; QwQ-32B-Preview, a model specifically designed for mathematical problem-solving with strong reasoning capabilities; and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, which serves as our base model for comparative analysis.
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 和 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: These comparative datasets include OpenThoughts-114k, a synthetic reasoning dataset containing 114k examples covering mathematics, science, coding, and puzzles
claim: 对比基线包括 OpenAI-o1-preview、QwQ-32B-Preview 和 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，以及用 OpenThoughts-114k 和 NuminaMath-100k 微调的模型 [S6.SS1.p1][S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: We collect and categorize these solutions into five distinct quality levels (L1-L5, with L5 being the highest)
claim: 此外还进行了推理链质量（L1–L5）、问题难度（Simple-500、Complex-500、Advanced-500）、预训练骨干（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat vs Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）和样本效率（400 到 2,000 样本）的消融分析 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p3][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: We select three sets of 500 problems with increasing difficulty: Simple-500 (MATH levels 1-2), Complex-500 (MATH levels 3-5), and Advanced-500 (AIME problems).
claim: 此外还进行了推理链质量（L1–L5）、问题难度（Simple-500、Complex-500、Advanced-500）、预训练骨干（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat vs Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）和样本效率（400 到 2,000 样本）的消融分析 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p3][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we compare two 32B-parameter models: Qwen1.5-32B-Chat and Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct (LIMO’s base model).
claim: 此外还进行了推理链质量（L1–L5）、问题难度（Simple-500、Complex-500、Advanced-500）、预训练骨干（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat vs Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）和样本效率（400 到 2,000 样本）的消融分析 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p3][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we fine-tune models from the Qwen2.5-Instruct series of varying sizes—3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B—using the LIMO dataset with 800 high-quality samples.
claim: 此外还进行了推理链质量（L1–L5）、问题难度（Simple-500、Complex-500、Advanced-500）、预训练骨干（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat vs Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）和样本效率（400 到 2,000 样本）的消融分析 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p3][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: we select top-ranked subsets of varying sizes—400, 800, 1,200, 1,600, and 2,000 questions—to construct five datasets (LIMO-400 through LIMO-2k).
claim: 此外还进行了推理链质量（L1–L5）、问题难度（Simple-500、Complex-500、Advanced-500）、预训练骨干（Qwen1.5-32B-Chat vs Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct）、模型规模（3B 到 72B）和样本效率（400 到 2,000 样本）的消融分析 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p2][S6.SS3.SSS2.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p1][S6.SS3.SSS3.p3][S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
claim: 在域内任务上，LIMO 在 AIME24 达到 63.3%，优于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；在 MATH500 达到 95.6%，优于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；在 AMC23 达到 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: On OlympiadBench, LIMO achieves 67.6% accuracy, significantly outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (58.5%) and the base model (45.3%).
claim: 在分布外任务上，LIMO 在 OlympiadBench 达到 67.6%，优于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 58.5% 和基座的 45.3%；在 CHMath 达到 84.2% 对 68.5%，在 GradeSchool 达到 76.2% 对 63.8%；在 GPQA 达到 70.7%，接近 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 73.3% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%) probably due to unfocused problem selection.
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 出现显著退化（32.3% 对基座 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: LIMO achieves the highest average performance of 78.1% across all benchmarks
claim: LIMO 在所有基准上平均性能最高，为 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px4.p1]。

quote: L5-trained models achieve highest results on both AIME24 and MATH500, with performance decreasing consistently with each quality level.
claim: 消融分析显示，推理链质量越高模型性能越好，L5 在 AIME24 和 MATH500 上最高 [S6.SS3.SSS1.p3]；

quote: Results in Figure 4 show that modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
claim: 仅改变问题选择即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 准确率提升，达到 51.5%，Advanced-500 训练的模型在 MATH500 上达到 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；

quote: LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
claim: 预训练骨干影响显著，LIMO（基于 Qwen2.5）在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 高 54.1 个百分点（63.3% 对 9.2%），在 MATH500 上高 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；

quote: The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
claim: 模型规模增大时 AIME24 从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差异微小（95.6% 对 94.8%），AIME24 上为 63.3% 对 68.3%，可能存在饱和点 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；

quote: Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
claim: 仅 400 样本即可将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升至 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升至 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减，2k 最佳（AIME24 69.6，MATH500 95.8）但相对 1.6k 提升很小 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: though the lower bound for maintaining effective performance remains an open question.
claim: 作者明确指出，维持有效性能所需的最小样本量下界仍是一个开放问题 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p1]。

quote: Future work could explore active learning strategies to further optimize sample efficiency.
claim: 此外，作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 论文指出当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知差以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLM 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实世界应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: The overall model architecture of Qwen2.5-VL consists of three components:
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 的整体架构由大语言模型、视觉编码器和基于 MLP 的视觉-语言融合器三部分组成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we incorporate 2D-RoPE and window attention to support native input resolutions while accelerating the computation of the entire visual encoder.
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算，大部分层使用窗口注意力，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: only four layers employ full self-attention, while the remaining layers utilize windowed attention with a maximum window size of 112×112
claim: 视觉编码器采用重新设计的 ViT，引入 2D-RoPE 和窗口注意力以支持原生输入分辨率并加速计算，大部分层使用窗口注意力，仅四层使用全自注意力 [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL introduces a key improvement: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time.
claim: 模型将 MRoPE 的时间分量与绝对时间对齐，使模型能在不同 FPS 采样率的视频间学习一致的时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
claim: 论文在多种数据集上评估 Qwen2.5-VL，并与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等最先进模型进行比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Then, we evaluate the model’s performance across various sub-capabilities.
claim: 评估覆盖通用视觉问答、文档理解与 OCR、空间理解、视频理解与定位以及智能体等多个子能力 [S3.p1]。

quote: we capped the maximum number of frames analyzed per video at 768, with the total number of video tokens not exceeding 24,576.
claim: 在视频评估中，每个视频分析的最大帧数限制为 768 帧，视频 token 总数不超过 24,576 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: 在 MMMU 上 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最先进模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
claim: 在 MathVista 上取得 74.8 分，超过此前开源最先进分数 72.3 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: largely exceeding best model Gemini 1.5-Pro by 9.6% and 20.6% for English and Chinese track respectively.
claim: 在 OCRBench_v2 上，Qwen2.5-VL 在英文和中文赛道分别超过最佳模型 Gemini 1.5-Pro 9.6% 和 20.6% [S3.SS3.SSS2.p4]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an impressive mIoU score of 50.9, thereby surpassing the performance of GPT-4o.
claim: 在 Charades-STA 上 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 取得 50.9 的 mIoU 分数，超过 GPT-4o [S3.SS3.SSS4.p2]。

quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
claim: 论文在讨论拒绝采样中的思维链推理时指出，视觉语言模型依赖文本和视觉两种模态，中间推理步骤可能无法充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们；尽管开发了基于规则和模型的过滤策略来验证中间推理步骤的准确性，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。
